description: G2: refuse any Write or Edit to a signed file (*-signed.*). The script prints a deny decision with the reason; it allows everything else.

hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/block_signed_writes.py"; IN=$(cat); for P in python3 python py; do command -v $P >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s' "$IN" | $P "$S" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; exit 0
